name: David

onAttack: You can't brute force your way through a proof.
Violence is not a valid step in the derivation.
Show your work. I'm not marking that.
onAct: Everything in a game is math.|Movement, collision, the curve on a jump.|You've been doing my homework all along.
Students think geometry is decoration.|Then they wonder why their hitboxes feel wrong.
A hexagon tiles the plane with the least perimeter per area.|Nature worked that out before either of us did.
You're not bad at this.|You're just impatient.
Numbers don't care how you feel about them.|That's the nicest thing about them.
onSpare: Mercy isn't a theorem. You can't prove it to me.
battleDialogue.onDefeat: Hm.|You found the shorter proof.|I've been doing it the long way for years....
battleDialogue.onSpared: You had the win and you didn't take it.|That's not a mistake. That's a choice.|Go on. The next door is yours.

descriptionByHp.text: David - HP 48, ATK 4. Teaches math at Tiltan.|Somehow both an ogre and a mathematician.

actOptions.name: Flex
extraMessages: David sizes up your form.|He seems to approve of the symmetry.

actOptions.name: Homework
actOptions.description: You ask David for an extension on the homework.
extraMessages: David considers it for a long, quiet moment.|He does not say no.

spareSuccessText: David steps aside and lets you through.

spareTextByPercent.text: David is listening more than he's arguing.

turnNarrationByHp.text: * David draws a shape in the air.
* David is down to his last example.

turnNarrationBySpare.text: * David waits for you to show your work.
* David seems less interested in the lesson.
* David is ready to call it here.
